sentences.en: Here's the price breakdown for the items you asked about.
sentences.zh: 这是您询问的商品的价格明细。

pattern.explain: Here's + 名词短语 → 用于呈现/提供信息，搭配 breakdown/list/details 等

variations.en: Here's the report you requested.
Here's the updated list.
Here's the info you needed.

pattern.extensions: 用于呈现任何信息：报告、数据、方案、结果、明细等

sentences.en: I've attached our latest price list for your reference.
sentences.zh: 我附上了我们最新的价格表供您参考。

pattern.explain: I've attached + 名词 + for your reference → 附上文件供参考的标准句式
pattern.native: I've attached the file for your reference.

variations.en: I've attached the catalog for your review.
variations.zh: 我已附上目录供您审核。

variations.en: I've attached the spec sheet for your team.
variations.zh: 我已经附上了您团队的规格表。

variations.en: I've attached the invoice for your records.
variations.zh: 我已附上发票供您记录。

pattern.extensions: 附上任何文件供对方参考：目录、规格表、发票、合同等

sentences.en: The unit price comes to $3.50, and that's already our best offer.
sentences.zh: 单价是$3.50，这已经是我们的最优价了。

pattern.explain: comes to + 金额 → 表示「算下来是」；that's already our best offer 强调底价

variations.en: The total comes to $500 for the order.
The final price comes to $2.80 per unit.

pattern.extensions: comes to + 金额：表示算下来的总价，可用于任何金额计算场景

sentences.en: Would you like me to send over a formal quotation?
sentences.zh: 需要我发一份正式报价单给您吗？

pattern.explain: Would you like me to + 动词 → 礼貌地提议做某事，send over = 发送
pattern.native: Want me to send the quote?

variations.en: Would you like me to send the catalog?
Would you like me to check the stock?
Would you like me to arrange samples?

pattern.extensions: 礼貌提议做某事：发文件、查库存、寄样品、安排通话等

sentences.en: Prices may vary depending on the quantity you order.
sentences.zh: 价格会根据您的订购数量有所不同。

pattern.explain: may vary depending on + 名词 → 「因…而异」，常用于说明价格浮动

variations.en: Shipping time may vary depending on your location.
variations.zh: 运送时间可能因您所在的地点而异。

variations.en: Costs may vary depending on the material.

pattern.extensions: 说明某事物因某因素而异：价格、时间、成本、质量等

sentences.en: This quote includes packaging but excludes shipping.
sentences.zh: 此报价包含包装但不包含运费。

pattern.explain: includes A but excludes B → 包含A但不包含B，正式报价常用
pattern.native: It includes packaging but not shipping.

variations.en: The price includes tax but excludes delivery.
variations.zh: 价格包含税费，但不包括派送费。

variations.en: The service includes setup but excludes maintenance.
variations.zh: 该服务包括设置，但不包括维护。

pattern.extensions: 说明包含和不包含的项目：报价、服务范围、套餐内容等

sentences.en: I can give you a better price if you can bump up the quantity.
sentences.zh: 如果您能增加数量，我可以给您更好的价格。

pattern.explain: I can + 动词 + if you can + 动词 → 条件交换句式；bump up = 增加/提高（口语）
pattern.native: I can do better on price if you order more.

variations.en: I can speed up production if you can confirm today.
variations.zh: 如果您今天能确认，我可以加快生产速度。

variations.en: I can offer free shipping if you can increase the quantity.
variations.zh: 如果您能增加数量，我可以提供免费送货。

pattern.extensions: 条件交换句式：以己方让步换取对方行动

sentences.en: The quote is valid for two weeks, so take your time.
sentences.zh: 报价有效期两周，您不用着急。

pattern.explain: valid for + 时间段 → 有效期为…；take your time = 别着急
pattern.native: The quote is good for two weeks.

variations.en: This offer is valid for 30 days.
The contract is valid for one year.

pattern.extensions: 说明有效期：报价、优惠、合同、要约等

sentences.en: Just to confirm, the total comes to $1,200 for 500 units.
sentences.zh: 跟您确认一下，500件总计$1,200。

pattern.explain: Just to confirm + 信息 → 确认信息的开头语；for + 数量 = 对应数量的价格

variations.en: Just to confirm, the delivery address is...?
Just to confirm, you want 500 units, right?
variations.zh: 只是想确认一下，你想要500个单元，对吧？

pattern.extensions: 确认信息开头语：确认地址、数量、时间、价格等

sentences.en: Let me know if the pricing works for you and I'll get the ball rolling.
sentences.zh: 如果价格合适的话告诉我，我就开始安排。

pattern.explain: Let me know if + 条件 → 等待对方确认；get the ball rolling = 开始行动（习语）
pattern.native: Let me know if that works.

variations.en: Let me know if you need more info.
variations.zh: 如果您需要更多信息，请联系我。

variations.en: Let me know if the price is acceptable.
variations.zh: 如果价格可以接受，请告诉我。

variations.en: Let me know if you'd like to proceed.
variations.zh: 如果您想继续操作，请告知我。

pattern.extensions: 万能确认句：等待对方回复是否可行、是否需要更多信息

sentences.en: We offer tiered pricing — the more you buy, the more you save.
sentences.zh: 我们有阶梯定价——买得越多省得越多。

pattern.explain: the more you A, the more you B → 越…越…句式，用于说明阶梯优惠

variations.en: The earlier you order, the faster you get it.
variations.zh: 越早下单，订单送达速度越快。

variations.en: The more you invest, the more you earn.

pattern.extensions: 越…越…句式：说明正相关的两个变量

sentences.en: That's our rock-bottom price, but I'll see what I can do.
sentences.zh: 那已经是我们的底价了，不过我看看能不能想想办法。

pattern.explain: rock-bottom price = 底价；I'll see what I can do = 我看看能不能想办法（委婉拒绝后留余地）

variations.en: That's the best we can do.
variations.zh: 这是我们能做的最好的事情。

variations.en: That's our bottom line.

pattern.extensions: 表达底价/最低价的多种说法：rock-bottom / best offer / bottom line

sentences.en: The MOQ is 500 units, and the price drops to $2.80 each at that volume.
sentences.zh: 起订量是500件，那个数量下单价降到$2.80。

pattern.explain: MOQ = Minimum Order Quantity 起订量；price drops to + 价格 → 降到某价格

variations.en: The MOQ is 1,000 pieces.
We require a minimum of 200 units.

pattern.extensions: 说明起订量及其价格影响

sentences.en: I can match that price if you can commit to a monthly order.
sentences.zh: 如果您能承诺每月下订单，我可以匹配那个价格。

pattern.explain: I can match that price + if + 条件 → 价格匹配的条件句；commit to = 承诺/保证
pattern.native: I can match that if you commit monthly.

variations.en: I can match the price if you increase the volume.
variations.zh: 如果您增加销量，我可以匹配价格。

variations.en: I can beat that price if you sign a yearly contract.
variations.zh: 如果你签年度合同，我可以打败这个价格。

pattern.extensions: 价格匹配+条件：以匹配/低于竞品价格换取对方承诺

sentences.en: Shipping is calculated separately based on your location.
sentences.zh: 运费根据您的地址单独计算。

pattern.explain: is calculated separately based on + 因素 → 基于某因素单独计算
pattern.native: Shipping is extra, based on where you are.

variations.en: Tax is calculated separately based on your region.
variations.zh: 税费根据您所在的地区单独计算。

variations.en: Installation is calculated separately based on complexity.
variations.zh: 安装是根据复杂性单独计算的。

pattern.extensions: 说明某费用单独计算：运费、税、安装费等

sentences.en: There's a 5% discount for orders above 1,000 units.
sentences.zh: 1000件以上的订单有5%的折扣。

pattern.explain: There's a X% discount for + 条件 → 某条件下有X%折扣

variations.en: There's a 10% discount for annual contracts.
variations.zh: 年度合同可享受10%的折扣。

variations.en: We offer a 3% discount for early payment.
variations.zh: 我们为提前付款提供3%的折扣。

pattern.extensions: 说明折扣条件：数量、合同期限、付款方式等

sentences.en: Would a 10% discount help seal the deal?
sentences.zh: 打9折能促成合作吗？

pattern.explain: Would + 方案 + help seal the deal? → 提出方案询问是否能成交；seal the deal = 达成交易

variations.en: Would free shipping help seal the deal?
variations.zh: 包邮是否有助于达成交易？

variations.en: Would a longer warranty seal the deal?
variations.zh: 更长的保修期是否会达成交易？

pattern.extensions: 提出方案促成交易：折扣、免邮、延保等

sentences.en: I've included both FOB and CIF prices in the quotation.
sentences.zh: 我在报价里同时包含了FOB和CIF价格。

pattern.explain: I've included A and B in + 文件 → 在文件中包含A和B；FOB/CIF = 国际贸易术语
pattern.native: I've included both FOB and CIF.

variations.en: We can quote EXW or FOB depending on your preference.
variations.zh: 我们可以根据您的偏好报价EXW或FOB。

variations.en: The CIF price includes insurance and freight.

pattern.extensions: 国际贸易术语报价：FOB / CIF / EXW / DDP 等

sentences.en: If the price is a bit over your budget, I can adjust the spec to bring it down.
sentences.zh: 如果价格超出您的预算，我可以调整规格来降低成本。

pattern.explain: If + 问题, I can + 解决方案 → 遇到问题的应对句式；bring it down = 降低价格
pattern.native: I can tweak the spec to lower the cost.

variations.en: I can adjust the material to bring the price down.
variations.zh: 我可以调整材料以降低价格。

variations.en: I can reduce the packaging to cut costs.
variations.zh: 我可以减少包装以降低成本。

pattern.extensions: 通过调整某方面来降低成本/价格

sentences.en: Could you give me a ballpark figure so I know what to expect?
sentences.zh: 您能给个大概价格让我心里有数吗？

pattern.explain: ballpark figure = 大概数字/估算；so I know what to expect = 让我心理有数
pattern.native: Can you give me a rough number?

variations.en: Just need a ballpark figure for the total.
variations.zh: 总共只需要一个粗略的数字。

variations.en: Give me a ballpark so I can budget.
variations.zh: 给我一个球场，这样我就可以预算了。

pattern.extensions: 询问大概数字/估算：价格、数量、时间等

sentences.en: Just a friendly reminder that your order is still pending payment.
sentences.zh: 友情提醒一下，您的订单还在等待付款。

pattern.explain: Just a friendly reminder that + 事实 → 委婉提醒，不带压力

variations.en: Just a friendly reminder that your invoice is due.
variations.zh: 温馨提示：您的发票已到期。

variations.en: Friendly reminder — the deadline is Friday.
variations.zh: 温馨提示：截止日期为周五。

pattern.extensions: 委婉提醒：付款、截止日期、会议等

sentences.en: Your items are all set and ready to ship once payment clears.
sentences.zh: 您的商品都准备好了，付款一到就能发货。

pattern.explain: ready to + 动词 + once + 条件 → 一旦条件满足就行动；payment clears = 付款到账
pattern.native: Ready to ship once you pay.

variations.en: Ready to go once you confirm the address.
We'll start production once we get the deposit.
variations.zh: 一旦我们收到押金，我们就会开始生产。

pattern.extensions: 一旦条件满足就行动：付款后发货、确认后生产、到账后安排

sentences.en: I wanted to check in on the order we discussed last week.
sentences.zh: 我想跟进一下我们上周讨论的那个订单。

pattern.explain: I wanted to check in on + 事项 → 跟进某事，比直接催更自然

variations.en: Just checking in on the status of your order.
variations.zh: 只需查看订单状态即可。

variations.en: Wanted to check in on the samples we sent.
variations.zh: 想检查一下我们发送的样品。

pattern.extensions: 跟进某事项：订单、样品、报价、申请等

sentences.en: Stock for this item is running low, so I'd suggest placing the order soon.
sentences.zh: 这款库存不多了，建议您尽快下单。

pattern.explain: is running low + so I'd suggest + 动词 → 说明紧迫性并建议行动

variations.en: We're running low on this item.
Inventory is running low for that SKU.

pattern.extensions: 说明库存紧张以促单：running low / almost out / limited stock

sentences.en: Just following up — were you able to review the quotation I sent?
sentences.zh: 跟进一下——您看到我发的报价了吗？

pattern.explain: Just following up — + 问句 → 先说「跟进」再提问，缓和语气
pattern.native: Following up — did you see my quote?

variations.en: Just following up on the email I sent.
variations.zh: 只是跟进我发送的电子邮件。

variations.en: Following up to see if you have any questions.
variations.zh: 跟进，看看您是否有任何疑问。

pattern.extensions: 跟进+提问：跟进邮件、报价、样品、订单等

sentences.en: No rush at all, just wanted to make sure you didn't miss my previous message.
sentences.zh: 完全不急，就是想确认您没有漏看我之前的消息。

pattern.explain: No rush at all, just wanted to + 目的 → 先说不急再提目的，避免施压感
pattern.native: No rush — just making sure you saw it.

variations.en: No rush at all, just wanted to flag this.
variations.zh: 一点也不着急，只是想举报一下。

variations.en: No rush, take your time reviewing.

pattern.extensions: 先说不急再提目的，降低施压感

sentences.en: If you're ready to move forward, I can get your order processed today.
sentences.zh: 如果您决定要了，我今天就能帮您处理订单。

pattern.explain: If you're ready to move forward → 如果您准备推进了；get + 名词 + processed = 让某事被处理
pattern.native: Ready to ship once you pay.

variations.en: Ready to go once you confirm the address.
We'll start production once we get the deposit.
variations.zh: 一旦我们收到押金，我们就会开始生产。

pattern.extensions: 一旦条件满足就行动：付款后发货、确认后生产、到账后安排

sentences.en: We're holding the stock for you, but we can only keep it until Friday.
sentences.zh: 我们在为您保留库存，但只能保留到周五。

pattern.explain: We're holding A for you, but can only keep it until + 时间 → 设定截止期限
pattern.native: We're holding it for you till Friday.

variations.en: I can hold the stock until next Monday.
variations.zh: 我可以持有股票到下周一。

variations.en: We'll keep the price locked for 48 hours.
variations.zh: 我们会将价格锁定48小时。

pattern.extensions: 为对方保留某物并设期限：库存、价格、名额等

sentences.en: Let me know if you need more time or if there's anything holding you back.
sentences.zh: 如果您需要更多时间或者有什么顾虑，请告诉我。

pattern.explain: Let me know if + 情况1 or if + 情况2 → 给对方两个选项，显得体贴
pattern.native: Let me know if that works.

variations.en: Let me know if you need more info.
variations.zh: 如果您需要更多信息，请联系我。

variations.en: Let me know if the price is acceptable.
variations.zh: 如果价格可以接受，请告诉我。

variations.en: Let me know if you'd like to proceed.
variations.zh: 如果您想继续操作，请告知我。

pattern.extensions: 万能确认句：等待对方回复是否可行、是否需要更多信息

sentences.en: Just a quick heads-up — the promotion ends this Sunday.
sentences.zh: 快速提醒一下——促销这周日就结束了。

pattern.explain: Just a quick heads-up — + 信息 → 快速提醒；heads-up = 预先提醒（口语）

variations.en: Quick heads-up — prices go up next month.
variations.zh: 快速提示—下个月价格会上涨。

variations.en: Just a heads-up — the factory closes next week.
variations.zh: 只是提醒一下—工厂下周关闭。

pattern.extensions: 预先提醒：促销结束、涨价、假期、截止日期等

sentences.en: The factory is closing for the holidays next week, so orders placed after today won't ship until after the break.
sentences.zh: 工厂下周放假，今天之后下的单假期后才能发货。

pattern.explain: A is closing for + 原因, so B won't + 动词 until + 时间 → 用客观原因制造紧迫感
pattern.native: Factory's closing for holidays — order soon.

variations.en: We're closing for CNY next week — last orders by Friday.
variations.zh: 我们下周将以人民币结束营业，最后订单截止日期为周五。

variations.en: Production pauses during the holiday — plan ahead.
variations.zh: 假期期间生产暂停—提前计划。

pattern.extensions: 用客观原因（假期/旺季/排期）制造紧迫感

sentences.en: I noticed the payment hasn't gone through yet — want me to resend the invoice?
sentences.zh: 我注意到付款还没到账——需要我重新发一下发票吗？

pattern.explain: I noticed + 事实 — want me to + 动词? → 先陈述观察再提供帮助
pattern.native: I noticed the payment hasn't gone through yet — want me to resend the invoice?

variations.en: I noticed the payment hasn't gone through yet — want me to resend the invoice?
variations.zh: 我注意到付款尚未完成—需要我重新发送发票吗？

pattern.extensions: 这个句式可以根据场景灵活替换关键词

sentences.en: Your cart's still sitting there — shall I help you finalize the order?
sentences.zh: 您的购物车还留着呢——需要我帮您完成下单吗？

pattern.explain: A's still sitting there → 暗示还没行动；shall I + 动词 = 要不要我来…
pattern.native: Your cart's still there — need help?

variations.en: Your order's still pending — shall I finalize it?
variations.zh: 您的订单仍在处理中，需要我完成吗？

variations.en: Your quote's still open — want to proceed?
variations.zh: 您的报价仍然有效—要继续吗？

pattern.extensions: 暗示对方还没行动并主动提供帮助

sentences.en: We've got a tight production schedule this month, so earlier orders get priority.
sentences.zh: 我们这个月生产排期紧，先下单的优先排产。

pattern.explain: We've got a tight schedule, so + 结果 → 用排期紧来鼓励尽快下单
pattern.native: Schedule's tight — earlier orders get priority.

variations.en: Production's full this month — earlier is better.
variations.zh: 本月产量已满—越早越好。

variations.en: We've got a packed schedule — book your slot early.
variations.zh: 我们的日程安排很紧凑，请提前预订您的时段。

pattern.extensions: 用排期紧张来鼓励尽快下单

sentences.en: Just circling back on this — do you have everything you need to make a decision?
sentences.zh: 再跟您确认一下——您需要的信息都齐了吗？

pattern.explain: Just circling back on this → 回头再跟一下（地道跟进表达）；make a decision = 做决定
pattern.native: Circling back — you have what you need?

variations.en: Just circling back on this — any updates?
variations.zh: 只是回过头来看一下—有什么更新吗？

variations.en: Circling back to see if you've made a decision.
variations.zh: 盘旋回去，看看你是否做出了决定。

pattern.extensions: 回头再跟一下：确认信息是否齐全、是否有进展

sentences.en: I can extend the discount to end of the month if that helps.
sentences.zh: 如果需要的话，我可以把折扣延长到月底。

pattern.explain: I can extend A to + 时间 if that helps → 提供延期作为促单手段
pattern.native: I can hold the discount till month-end.

variations.en: I can extend the offer by one week.
variations.zh: 我可以将报价延长一周。

variations.en: I can extend the deadline to next Friday.
variations.zh: 我可以将截止日期延长到下周五。

pattern.extensions: 提供延期作为促单手段：折扣、报价、截止日期

sentences.en: Other customers have been snapping this up, so I wanted to give you first dibs.
sentences.zh: 其他客户在抢这款了，我想先给您留着。

pattern.explain: give you first dibs = 给你优先权（地道口语）；snapping up = 抢购
pattern.native: Others are buying — want me to hold one?

variations.en: I'm giving you first dibs on the new stock.
variations.zh: 我首先向你介绍新股票。

variations.en: Other buyers are interested — want to lock yours in?
variations.zh: 其他买家有兴趣—想要锁定您的？

pattern.extensions: 用其他客户在抢来制造紧迫感+给优先权

sentences.en: Payment was due last Friday — could you check on your end?
sentences.zh: 付款上周五就到期了——您那边能查一下吗？

pattern.explain: Payment was due + 时间 — could you + 动词? → 明确指出到期日并请求行动
pattern.native: Payment was due Friday — can you check?

variations.en: The invoice was due last week — any updates?
variations.zh: 发票已于上周到期—有任何更新吗？

variations.en: Your balance is due today — shall I send a reminder?
variations.zh: 您的余额今天到期，需要我发送提醒吗？

pattern.extensions: 明确指出到期日并请求行动：付款、提交、回复等

sentences.en: Once I receive the deposit, I'll lock in the price and start production right away.
sentences.zh: 一收到定金我就锁定价格，马上开始生产。

pattern.explain: Once I receive A, I'll + 动词 → 明确告诉对方付了款之后的下一步
pattern.native: Once I get the deposit, I'll start right away.

variations.en: Once I receive confirmation, I'll ship today.
variations.zh: 收到确认后，我今天发货。

variations.en: Once the deposit clears, I'll lock the price.
variations.zh: 押金结清后，我会锁定价格。

pattern.extensions: 说明收到某物后的下一步：定金、确认、付款等

sentences.en: Just give me a yes or no by Wednesday and we're all set either way.
sentences.zh: 周三前给我个准信就行，行不行都没关系。

pattern.explain: Just give me a yes or no by + 时间 → 设定简单回复期限；either way = 无论如何
pattern.native: Just need a yes or no by Wednesday.

variations.en: Give me a yes or no by Friday either way.
variations.zh: 无论如何，请在周五之前回答“是”或“否”。

variations.en: Just let me know yes or no — no pressure.
variations.zh: 只需告诉我是或否—没有压力。

pattern.extensions: 设定简单回复期限，降低对方回复门槛

sentences.en: Hope you've had a chance to look through the catalog I sent.
sentences.zh: 希望您有时间看了我发的目录。

pattern.explain: Hope you've had a chance to + 动词 → 委婉询问对方是否看过，不带压力
pattern.native: Did you get a chance to look at the catalog?

variations.en: Hope you've had a chance to review the quote.
variations.zh: 希望您有机会查看报价。

variations.en: Did you have time to check the samples?

pattern.extensions: 委婉询问对方是否看过某物：目录、报价、样品、邮件

sentences.en: Just checking in to see if you have any questions about the products.
sentences.zh: 跟进一下，看看您对产品有没有什么问题。

pattern.explain: Just checking in to see if + 问句 → 跟进+询问，很自然的开场白

variations.en: Just checking in to see if you need anything.
variations.zh: 只需办理入住手续，看看您是否需要任何东西。

variations.en: Checking in — were you able to review the catalog?
variations.zh: 入住—您是否能够查看目录？

pattern.extensions: 跟进+询问，自然的开场白

sentences.en: It was great talking to you earlier — let's keep the conversation going!
sentences.zh: 很高兴之前和您聊过，我们继续保持联系！

pattern.explain: It was great + 动名词 — let's + 动词 → 先回顾愉快交流，再提议继续
pattern.native: Great talking earlier — let's stay in touch!

variations.en: It was great meeting you at the show.
variations.zh: 很高兴在展会上见到你。

variations.en: Really enjoyed our call — let's keep talking.
variations.zh: 非常喜欢我们的通话—让我们继续交谈。

pattern.extensions: 回顾愉快交流后提议继续保持联系

sentences.en: I'm reaching out to see how things are going with your current order.
sentences.zh: 我想了解一下您当前订单的情况。

pattern.explain: I'm reaching out to + 动词 → 主动联系的礼貌说法；how things are going = 进展如何
pattern.native: Reaching out to check on your order.

variations.en: I'm reaching out to see if you need any updates.
variations.zh: 此次联系您是为了了解您是否需要任何更新。

variations.en: Just reaching out to share our new catalog.
variations.zh: 只是想分享我们的新目录。

pattern.extensions: 主动联系的礼貌说法：跟进、分享信息、问候

sentences.en: Did the samples work out for you? I'd love to hear your feedback.
sentences.zh: 样品您觉得怎么样？很想听听您的反馈。

pattern.explain: Did A work out for you? → 询问某事是否合适/满意；work out = 行得通/有结果

variations.en: Did the samples work out for your tests?
variations.zh: 样本是否适合您的测试？

variations.en: How did the trial work out?

pattern.extensions: 询问某事是否合适/有结果：样品、试用、方案、测试

sentences.en: Let me know if there's anything else I can help you with.
sentences.zh: 如果还有什么我能帮到的，请告诉我。

pattern.explain: Let me know if there's anything else I can + 动词 → 结束对话时的万能句式
pattern.native: Let me know if that works.

variations.en: Let me know if you need more info.
variations.zh: 如果您需要更多信息，请联系我。

variations.en: Let me know if the price is acceptable.
variations.zh: 如果价格可以接受，请告诉我。

variations.en: Let me know if you'd like to proceed.
variations.zh: 如果您想继续操作，请告知我。

pattern.extensions: 万能确认句：等待对方回复是否可行、是否需要更多信息

sentences.en: I'll be your go-to person from here on out, so feel free to reach out anytime.
sentences.zh: 以后我就是您的专属对接人，随时可以联系我。

pattern.explain: go-to person = 专属联系人/负责人；feel free to + 动词 = 随时可以…
pattern.native: I'm your point of contact going forward.

variations.en: I'll be handling your account from now on.
variations.zh: 从现在开始，我会处理您的账号。

variations.en: I'm your dedicated account manager.
variations.zh: 我是您的专属客户经理。

pattern.extensions: 介绍专属对接人/负责人

sentences.en: We've got some new arrivals coming in next week — want me to send you a sneak peek?
sentences.zh: 我们下周有新品到货，要不要先给您看看？

pattern.explain: sneak peek = 提前看/先睹为快；want me to + 动词 = 要不要我…
pattern.native: Want a sneak peek at our new line?

variations.en: Here's a sneak peek of the upcoming collection.
variations.zh: 以下是即将推出的系列的先睹为快。

variations.en: Want a sneak peek before we launch?
variations.zh: 想在我们推出之前先睹为快吗？

pattern.extensions: 提供提前看/先睹为快的机会：新品、方案、报告

sentences.en: Just wanted to touch base and see if you're still interested in moving forward.
sentences.zh: 想跟您确认一下，是否还有兴趣继续推进。

pattern.explain: touch base = 联系/沟通（地道商务表达）；moving forward = 继续推进

variations.en: Just wanted to touch base about the project.
variations.zh: 我只是想接触一下这个项目的基础。

variations.en: Let's touch base next week to discuss.
variations.zh: 让我们下周联系BASE进行讨论。

pattern.extensions: 联系/沟通的地道商务表达：跟进项目、确认进展、安排会议

sentences.en: Thanks for sticking with us — we really appreciate your business.
sentences.zh: 感谢您一直选择我们——真的很感谢您的支持。

pattern.explain: sticking with us = 继续支持我们；appreciate your business = 感谢您的惠顾

variations.en: We really appreciate your loyalty.
variations.zh: 我们非常感谢您的忠诚。

variations.en: Thanks for choosing us again.

pattern.extensions: 感谢客户持续支持/惠顾

sentences.en: I wanted to follow up on the sample we sent over last week.
sentences.zh: 我想跟进一下上周寄给您的样品。

pattern.explain: follow up on + 事项 → 跟进某事；sent over = 寄出/发出
pattern.native: Following up on the samples we sent.

variations.en: I wanted to follow up on our last conversation.
variations.zh: 我想跟进我们最后的谈话。

variations.en: Just following up on the quote from last week.

pattern.extensions: 跟进具体事项：样品、对话、报价、邮件

sentences.en: Just wondering if you had a chance to test the samples yet.
sentences.zh: 想问一下您有没有来得及测试样品。

pattern.explain: Just wondering if + 问句 → 委婉询问，比直接问更礼貌
pattern.native: Did you test the samples yet?

variations.en: Just wondering if you had any feedback.
variations.zh: 我只是想知道您是否有任何反馈。

variations.en: Wondering if you've made a decision yet.
variations.zh: 想知道您是否已经做出了决定。

pattern.extensions: 委婉询问，比直接问更礼貌

sentences.en: How's the market response on your end? Any feedback would be super helpful.
sentences.zh: 您那边市场反响怎么样？任何反馈都非常有帮助。

pattern.explain: How's + 事项 on your end? → 询问对方那边的情况；super helpful = 非常有帮助（口语加强）
pattern.native: How's it going on your side?

variations.en: What's the situation on your end?
Any updates from your team?
variations.zh: 您的团队有什么最新动态吗？

pattern.extensions: 询问对方那边的情况：市场反响、项目进展、团队意见

sentences.en: I'm putting together a special offer for our loyal customers — I'll send it your way soon.
sentences.zh: 我在给老客户准备一个特别优惠——很快发给您。

pattern.explain: putting together = 整理/准备；send it your way = 发给你（地道口语）
pattern.native: I'm putting together a special deal for you.

variations.en: We're putting together a customized package.
variations.zh: 我们正在整理定制的套餐。

variations.en: I'm working on a proposal for your team.
variations.zh: 我正在为您的团队制定提案。

pattern.extensions: 正在准备/整理某物：方案、优惠、提案、报告

sentences.en: It's been a while since we last caught up — how have you been?
sentences.zh: 我们好久没联系了——您最近怎么样？

pattern.explain: It's been a while since + 时间/事件 → 好久没…的客气开头；caught up = 聊天/叙旧
pattern.native: Long time no talk — how've you been?

variations.en: It's been a while since we last spoke.
variations.zh: 我们上次说话已经有一段时间了。

variations.en: Haven't heard from you in a while — everything OK?
variations.zh: 有一段时间没有您的消息了—一切都好吗？

pattern.extensions: 好久没联系的客气开头

sentences.en: I came across something that reminded me of your business and thought I'd reach out.
sentences.zh: 我看到一个东西想起了您的业务，就想联系您一下。

pattern.explain: came across = 偶然看到；thought I'd + 动词 = 想着不如…（自然的联系理由）
pattern.native: Saw something that reminded me of you.

variations.en: Came across an article you might like.
variations.zh: 浏览了一篇您可能会喜欢的文章。

variations.en: I found a product that fits your needs.
variations.zh: 我找到了一款符合您需求的产品。

pattern.extensions: 以偶然看到某物为理由联系对方

sentences.en: Just a quick note to say thanks for your continued partnership.
sentences.zh: 简单跟您说一声，感谢您一直以来的合作。

pattern.explain: Just a quick note to + 动词 → 简短留言的常用开头；continued partnership = 持续合作
pattern.native: Quick note — thanks for your partnership!

variations.en: Just a quick note to say thanks.
A quick note to update you on the project.
variations.zh: 为您提供有关项目的最新信息的简短说明。

pattern.extensions: 简短留言的常用开头：感谢、更新、提醒

sentences.en: We're updating our product line next quarter — I'll keep you in the loop.
sentences.zh: 我们下季度要更新产品线——我会让您随时了解。

pattern.explain: keep you in the loop = 让你持续知情（地道口语）；product line = 产品线

variations.en: I'll keep you updated on the progress.
variations.zh: 我会及时告知您最新进展。

variations.en: We'll keep you in the loop on any changes.
variations.zh: 如有任何更改，我们会及时通知您。

pattern.extensions: 让对方持续知情：项目进展、变更、更新

sentences.en: Let's schedule a quick call to go over the next steps when you have a moment.
sentences.zh: 您有空的时候我们简单通个话，过一下下一步。

pattern.explain: schedule a quick call → 安排简短通话；go over = 过一遍/讨论
pattern.native: Let's do a quick call when you're free.

variations.en: Can we schedule a call to discuss next steps?
variations.zh: 我们可以安排一次通话来讨论后续步骤吗？

variations.en: Let's hop on a call to go over the details.
variations.zh: 让我们继续通话，了解详情。

pattern.extensions: 安排简短通话讨论下一步/细节

sentences.en: I really appreciate your patience throughout this process.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您在整个过程中的耐心。

pattern.explain: appreciate your patience → 感谢耐心（万能结尾句）；throughout = 贯穿整个过程

variations.en: I appreciate your patience while we sort this out.
variations.zh: 感谢您在我们解决此问题期间的耐心等待。

variations.en: Thank you for your patience during the delay.
variations.zh: 感谢您在延迟期间的耐心等待。

pattern.extensions: 感谢对方耐心的万能句：处理问题、等待、延迟

sentences.en: Hi, this is XIU from [Company Name] — do you have a quick minute?
sentences.zh: 你好，我是[公司名]的XIU——您现在方便接电话吗？

pattern.explain: this is + 名字 + from + 公司 → 电话自我介绍；a quick minute = 简短聊几句

variations.en: Hi, this is XIU calling from [Company].
Hello, my name is XIU, I'm with [Company].

pattern.extensions: 电话自我介绍的标准句式

sentences.en: I'm calling about a product line that might be a good fit for your market.
sentences.zh: 我打电话是想介绍一款可能适合您市场的产品。

pattern.explain: I'm calling about + 事项 → 说明来电话的目的；a good fit for = 适合
pattern.native: Calling about a product for your market.

variations.en: I'm calling about the inquiry you sent.
variations.zh: 此次联系您是关于您发送的咨询。

variations.en: I'm calling regarding the order we discussed.
variations.zh: 此次联系您是关于我们讨论的订单。

pattern.extensions: 说明来电话的目的：介绍产品、跟进询盘、讨论订单

sentences.en: Would you be open to a quick 5-minute chat about how we could help your business?
sentences.zh: 您愿意花5分钟聊聊我们能怎么帮到您的业务吗？

pattern.explain: Would you be open to + 名词/动名词 → 询问对方是否愿意考虑；be open to = 持开放态度

variations.en: Would you be open to a product demo?
variations.zh: 您是否愿意接受产品演示？

variations.en: Would you be open to trying a free sample?
variations.zh: 您是否愿意尝试免费样品？

pattern.extensions: 询问对方是否愿意考虑某事：通话、演示、试用

sentences.en: I won't take up much of your time — I just wanted to introduce ourselves.
sentences.zh: 不会占用您太多时间——我就简单介绍一下我们。

pattern.explain: I won't take up much of your time → 先消除对方顾虑；take up = 占用

variations.en: I'll keep it brief — just two minutes.
variations.zh: 我会保持简短—只需两分钟。

variations.en: This will only take a minute of your time.
variations.zh: 这只会占用您一分钟的时间。

pattern.extensions: 先消除对方顾虑：不会占用太多时间

sentences.en: Is this a good time to talk, or would you prefer I call back later?
sentences.zh: 现在说话方便吗，还是我稍后再打过来？

pattern.explain: Is this a good time to talk, or... → 给对方选择权，显得尊重

variations.en: Is this a good time to talk, or should I call back?
variations.zh: 现在是聊天的好时机，还是我应该回电？

variations.en: Did I catch you at a bad time?
variations.zh: 我在不合适的时间抓住你了吗？

pattern.extensions: 询问是否方便说话，给对方选择权

sentences.en: Can I send you some info by email so you can take a look when you're free?
sentences.zh: 我能不能发些资料到您邮箱，您有空的时候看看？

pattern.explain: Can I + 动词 + so you can + 动词 → 提议做A以便对方做B
pattern.native: Can I email you the details to look at later?

variations.en: I can send the catalog so you can browse at your pace.
variations.zh: 我可以发送目录，以便您按照自己的节奏浏览。

variations.en: Let me email the specs so you can review with your team.
variations.zh: 让我通过电子邮件发送规格，以便您与您的团队一起审核。

pattern.extensions: 提议做A以便对方做B：发资料以便对方查看

sentences.en: I'd love to send you some free samples — no strings attached.
sentences.zh: 我想给您寄些免费样品——没有任何附加条件。

pattern.explain: no strings attached = 无附加条件（地道口语），降低对方顾虑

variations.en: We'll send samples — completely free, no obligation.
variations.zh: 我们将发送样品—完全免费，没有义务。

variations.en: Try it risk-free, no strings attached.
variations.zh: 尝试零风险，无附加条件。

pattern.extensions: 强调无附加条件以降低对方顾虑

sentences.en: I got your contact from a mutual connection and thought I'd reach out.
sentences.zh: 我从一个共同朋友那得到您的联系方式，想联系一下。

pattern.explain: I got your contact from + 来源 → 说明联系方式来源；mutual connection = 共同人脉

variations.en: I got your number from a mutual friend.
variations.zh: 我从一个共同的朋友那里得到了你的电话号码。

variations.en: [Name] suggested I reach out to you.

pattern.extensions: 说明联系方式来源以建立信任

sentences.en: I'm following up on the email I sent last Tuesday — did it come through?
sentences.zh: 我跟进一下上周二发的邮件——您收到了吗？

pattern.explain: did it come through? → 收到了吗？（地道口语）；come through = 到达

variations.en: Did you receive the catalog I sent?
variations.zh: 您收到我发送的目录了吗？

variations.en: Just checking — did my last email come through?
variations.zh: 只是检查—我的上一封电子邮件是否收到？

pattern.extensions: 确认邮件/消息是否收到

sentences.en: To be honest, I'm not sure if this is a fit yet, but I thought it was worth a quick call.
sentences.zh: 说实话我不确定是否合适，但觉得值得一聊。

pattern.explain: To be honest → 坦白说（降低防备）；worth a quick call = 值得打这个电话
pattern.native: Honestly, not sure if it's a fit yet.

variations.en: To be honest, I'm not sure if this is right for you.
variations.zh: 老实说，我不确定这是否适合您。

variations.en: Honestly, this might not be what you're looking for.
variations.zh: 老实说，这可能不是您想要的。

pattern.extensions: 坦白说…降低对方防备，显得真诚

sentences.en: I'll keep it brief — we're a supplier that specializes in [product category].
sentences.zh: 我简单说——我们是专门做[品类]的供应商。

pattern.explain: I'll keep it brief → 我简单说（表示不会啰嗦）；specializes in = 专做
pattern.native: I'll keep it short — we make [product].

variations.en: Long story short, we supply [category].
In a nutshell, we're a [category] supplier.
variations.zh: 简而言之，我们是[CATEGORY]供应商。

pattern.extensions: 表示不会啰嗦，快速说明核心信息

sentences.en: If now's not ideal, how about I call you back tomorrow morning?
sentences.zh: 如果现在不方便，我明天上午再打给您怎么样？

pattern.explain: If now's not ideal → 如果现在不合适（委婉）；how about + 方案 = 要不要…
pattern.native: Bad time? I can call back tomorrow.

variations.en: If now doesn't work, how about tomorrow morning?
variations.zh: 如果现在不行，明天早上怎么样？

variations.en: I can call back at a better time if you prefer.
variations.zh: 如果您愿意，我可以在更好的时间回电。

pattern.extensions: 如果现在不方便，提供替代时间

sentences.en: Just to give you a quick idea — our lead times are 30% shorter than the industry average.
sentences.zh: 简单让您了解一下——我们的交货期比行业平均短30%。

pattern.explain: Just to give you a quick idea → 简单介绍（口语）；lead times = 交货期
pattern.native: Quick overview — our lead times are 30% faster.

variations.en: Just to give you an idea — we ship in 3-5 days.
variations.zh: 只是想给您一个想法—我们会在3-5天内发货。

variations.en: To give you a quick idea — our MOQ is 500 units.
variations.zh: 为了让您快速了解—我们的起订量为500单位。

pattern.extensions: 快速介绍某个关键信息：交期、起订量、价格优势

sentences.en: I completely understand if it's not the right time — can I at least leave my contact info?
sentences.zh: 我完全理解如果现在不是合适的时候——我至少留个联系方式可以吗？

pattern.explain: I completely understand → 表示理解（降低压力）；at least + 请求 = 至少…
pattern.native: Totally get it — can I just leave my info?

variations.en: I completely understand — no worries at all.
variations.zh: 我完全理解，完全不用担心。

variations.en: I understand it's not the right time — I'll follow up later.
variations.zh: 我知道现在时机不对，我会稍后跟进。

pattern.extensions: 表示理解对方拒绝，仍留下后路

sentences.en: Thanks for taking my call — I'll send a follow-up email right away so you have it in writing.
sentences.zh: 感谢您接我电话——我马上发一封跟进邮件，方便您留存。

pattern.explain: Thanks for taking my call → 感谢接电话（礼貌结尾）；in writing = 书面形式
pattern.native: Thanks for picking up — I'll email the details.

variations.en: Appreciate you taking the time to talk.
variations.zh: 感谢您抽出宝贵时间与我们交谈。

variations.en: Thanks for the call — I'll send a summary email.
variations.zh: 感谢您的来电—我会发送一封摘要电子邮件。

pattern.extensions: 感谢接电话后的礼貌结尾

sentences.en: Let me put that in an email with a detailed breakdown so you can review it at your own pace.
sentences.zh: 我把这个整理成邮件，带详细明细，您可以自己节奏看。

pattern.explain: at your own pace → 按你自己的节奏（不强迫）；put that in an email = 整理成邮件

variations.en: Take your time going through the details.
variations.zh: 花点时间仔细研究细节。

variations.en: You can review the proposal at your own pace.
variations.zh: 您可以按照自己的进度审核提案。

pattern.extensions: 让对方按自己节奏查看，不强迫

sentences.en: What would be the best way to stay in touch — email or WhatsApp?
sentences.zh: 以后怎么联系您比较方便——邮件还是WhatsApp？

pattern.explain: What would be the best way to + 动词 → 询问最佳方式；stay in touch = 保持联系
pattern.native: What would be the best way to stay in touch — email or WhatsApp?

variations.en: What would be the best way to stay in touch — email or WhatsApp?
variations.zh: 保持联系的最佳方式是什么—电子邮件或WhatsApp ？

pattern.extensions: 这个句式可以根据场景灵活替换关键词

sentences.en: I'll shoot you a text with my contact details after we hang up.
sentences.zh: 挂了电话后我发条短信把我的联系方式给您。

pattern.explain: shoot you a text = 发短信给你（地道口语）；hang up = 挂电话
pattern.native: I'll text you my info after we hang up.

variations.en: I'll shoot you an email with the details.
variations.zh: 我会给您发送一封包含详细信息的电子邮件。

variations.en: Let me send you a quick message with my contact.
variations.zh: 让我给我的联系人发一条简短的消息。

pattern.extensions: 挂电话后发消息/邮件：发送联系方式、确认细节

sentences.en: Is there someone else on your team I should be speaking with about this?
sentences.zh: 您团队里是否有其他人更适合聊这个话题？

pattern.explain: Is there someone else I should be speaking with → 礼貌询问对接人
pattern.native: Should I talk to someone else on your team?

variations.en: Is there someone else who handles this?
variations.zh: 是否有其他人负责处理此事？

variations.en: Who's the right person to discuss this with?
variations.zh: 谁是讨论这个问题的合适人选？

pattern.extensions: 礼貌询问正确对接人

sentences.en: Thanks for your time today — I'll follow up with those details by end of day.
sentences.zh: 感谢您今天的时间——我今天下班前把那些细节发给您。

pattern.explain: Thanks for your time → 感谢时间（结尾礼貌）；by end of day = 今天下班前
pattern.native: I'll send those details by EOD.

variations.en: I'll get back to you by end of day.
variations.zh: 我会在一天结束前回复您。

variations.en: I'll have the numbers ready by tomorrow morning.
variations.zh: 我明天早上会把号码准备好。

pattern.extensions: 承诺在某个时间前完成：今天下班前、明天早上、本周内

sentences.en: So sorry about the mix-up — let me get that sorted for you right away.
sentences.zh: 抱歉搞混了，我马上帮您处理。

pattern.explain: mix-up = 搞混/弄错（名词）；get that sorted = 解决处理（地道口语）
pattern.native: Sorry about the mix-up — fixing it now.

variations.en: Apologies for the confusion — I'm on it.
variations.zh: 很抱歉给您带来困惑，我正在处理。

variations.en: Sorry about the mistake — let me sort it out.
variations.zh: 很抱歉出错了，让我来处理一下。

pattern.extensions: 为搞混/弄错道歉并立即处理

sentences.en: I totally understand your frustration, and I'm here to make it right.
sentences.zh: 我完全理解您的心情，我会帮您解决的。

pattern.explain: make it right = 纠正错误/弥补（地道表达），比 fix it 更温暖
pattern.native: I'll make this right for you.

variations.en: Let me make it right — I promise.
We'll do whatever it takes to make it right.
variations.zh: 我们会尽一切努力纠正错误。

pattern.extensions: 承诺纠正错误/弥补，比 fix it 更温暖

sentences.en: I've gone ahead and issued a full refund to your original payment method.
sentences.zh: 我已经为您发起了全额退款，退到原来的付款方式。

pattern.explain: issue a refund = 发起退款；original payment method = 原付款方式

variations.en: I've issued a partial refund to your account.
variations.zh: 我们已向您的账号发放部分退款。

variations.en: The refund has been processed to your original payment method.
variations.zh: 退款已发放至您原先使用的付款方式。

pattern.extensions: 发起退款：全额、部分、退到原支付方式

sentences.en: We'd be happy to send you a replacement at no extra cost.
sentences.zh: 我们很乐意免费给您补发一份。

pattern.explain: at no extra cost = 免费/无额外费用；replacement = 替换品
pattern.native: We'll send a replacement free of charge.

variations.en: We'll replace it at no cost to you.
We'll send a new one — no charge.
variations.zh: 我们会重新发送，不收取任何费用。

pattern.extensions: 免费提供：补发、换货、升级

sentences.en: Could you share a quick photo of what you received so I can look into it?
sentences.zh: 您能拍张收到物品的照片让我看看吗？

pattern.explain: look into it = 调查/查看（地道口语）；share a photo = 分享照片
pattern.native: Can you send a photo so I can check?

variations.en: Let me look into this and get back to you.
variations.zh: 让我调查一下并回复您。

variations.en: I'll look into the issue right away.

pattern.extensions: 调查/查看问题：请求照片、查看记录、联系仓库

sentences.en: Thanks for bearing with us while we sort this out.
sentences.zh: 感谢您在我们处理过程中的耐心等待。

pattern.explain: bearing with us = 耐心等待/容忍（地道表达）；sort out = 解决

variations.en: Appreciate you bearing with us during this.
variations.zh: 感谢您在此期间与我们合作。

variations.en: Thanks for waiting while we sort this out.
variations.zh: 感谢您耐心等待我们解决此问题。

pattern.extensions: 感谢对方耐心等待/容忍

sentences.en: You have my word — we'll make this right for you.
sentences.zh: 我们向您保证——一定会给您一个满意的解决方案。

pattern.explain: You have my word → 我向你保证（比 I promise 更口语化）

variations.en: You have my word — it won't happen again.
variations.zh: 我向你保证，这种情况不会再发生了。

variations.en: I give you my word — we'll resolve this.
variations.zh: 我向您保证，我们会解决这个问题。

pattern.extensions: 向客户保证，比 I promise 更口语化

sentences.en: I hear you — that's definitely not the experience we want you to have.
sentences.zh: 我理解您的感受——这绝对不是我们希望您有的体验。

pattern.explain: I hear you = 我听到了/我理解你（共情表达）；definitely not = 绝对不是
pattern.native: I get it — that's not OK.

variations.en: I completely understand how you feel.
I hear you, and I'm going to fix this.
variations.zh: 我明白了，我会解决这个问题。

pattern.extensions: 共情表达：我理解你/我听到了你的诉求

sentences.en: Let me check with the warehouse and get right back to you.
sentences.zh: 让我跟仓库确认一下，马上回复您。

pattern.explain: get right back to you = 马上回复你（地道口语）；check with = 跟…确认
pattern.native: I'll check and get right back to you.

variations.en: Let me verify with the warehouse and call you back.
variations.zh: 让我与仓库核实一下，然后给您回电。

variations.en: I'll look into it and respond within the hour.
variations.zh: 我会调查此事，并在一小时内回复。

pattern.extensions: 马上回复对方：查仓库后回复、一小时内回复

sentences.en: I've flagged this as urgent, so it'll be processed first thing tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我已经标记为紧急了，明天一早就处理。

pattern.explain: flagged this as urgent = 标记为紧急；first thing tomorrow = 明天第一件事
pattern.native: I've marked this as urgent — first thing tomorrow.

variations.en: I've escalated this to our priority queue.
variations.zh: 我已将此问题升级至我们的优先级队列。

variations.en: I've flagged this for immediate processing.
variations.zh: 我已标记此事，以便立即处理。

pattern.extensions: 标记为紧急/优先处理：加急、升级、优先排

sentences.en: Can you walk me through what happened so I can figure out the best fix?
sentences.zh: 您能跟我描述一下发生了什么吗，这样我好找最佳解决方案。

pattern.explain: walk me through → 一步步给我讲；figure out = 想清楚/弄明白
pattern.native: Can you tell me what happened step by step?

variations.en: Walk me through the issue so I can help.
variations.zh: 请指导我解决问题，以便我提供帮助。

variations.en: Can you describe what went wrong?
variations.zh: 您能描述一下出了什么问题吗？

pattern.extensions: 请对方一步步描述经过：报错、故障、投诉

sentences.en: Good news — your order's already on its way!
sentences.zh: 好消息——您的订单已经在路上了！

pattern.explain: on its way = 在路上了（简洁好消息表达）

variations.en: Your order is on its way to you.
The replacement is already in transit.

pattern.extensions: 好消息表达：已在路上/已发货/已寄出

sentences.en: Your order was split into two shipments — they'll arrive a day apart.
sentences.zh: 您的订单分成了两批发货——会差一天到。

pattern.explain: split into = 分成；a day apart = 相差一天
pattern.native: We split it into two shipments.

variations.en: The order was split into three deliveries.
We'll send it in two separate packages.
variations.zh: 我们将以两个不同的包裹寄送。

pattern.extensions: 分成多批：分批发货、多包裹、多批次

sentences.en: The courier attempted delivery but no one was home — they'll try again tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 快递尝试派送但没人在家——明天会再试。

pattern.explain: attempted delivery = 尝试派送；no one was home = 没人在家
pattern.native: Courier tried to deliver but no one was home.

variations.en: Delivery was attempted but failed — they'll retry tomorrow.
variations.zh: 已尝试派送但失败，他们将在明天重试。

variations.en: The courier couldn't reach you — can we reschedule?
variations.zh: 派送员无法联系到您，我们可以重新预约吗？

pattern.extensions: 快递尝试派送失败：没人、地址错误、联系不上

sentences.en: I'll personally keep an eye on your order and update you every step of the way.
sentences.zh: 我会亲自盯着的您的货，每一步都跟您更新。

pattern.explain: keep an eye on = 关注/盯着；every step of the way = 每一步
pattern.native: I'll personally track this for you.

variations.en: I'll keep an eye on your order and update you.
variations.zh: 我们会密切留意您的订单并告知您最新情况。

variations.en: I'll monitor the shipment closely.

pattern.extensions: 表示会亲自关注/监控：订单、物流、进度

sentences.en: Your order's arrived at the local sorting center — it should go out for delivery tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 您的订单到了本地分拣中心——明早应该会派送。

pattern.explain: sorting center = 分拣中心；go out for delivery = 出发派送
pattern.native: It's at the local sorting center — out for delivery tomorrow.

variations.en: Your package arrived at the distribution center.
variations.zh: 您的包裹已送达配送中心。

variations.en: It's at the local hub — delivery scheduled for tomorrow.
variations.zh: 订单餐点位于当地派送枢纽，预计明天送达。

pattern.extensions: 物流状态更新：分拣中心、配送站、转运中心

sentences.en: I've contacted the courier and they're prioritizing your delivery — you should get it today.
sentences.zh: 我已经联系快递了，他们在优先派送——今天内到。

pattern.explain: prioritizing = 优先处理；you should get it today = 今天应该能到

variations.en: I've asked them to prioritize your package.
variations.zh: 我已要求他们优先考虑您的套餐。

variations.en: Your delivery has been marked as priority.
variations.zh: 您的派送已被标记为优先级。

pattern.extensions: 优先处理：优先派送、优先排产、优先处理

sentences.en: Sorry for the delay — turns out the package was held up at customs.
sentences.zh: 抱歉延迟了——原来包裹在海关被拦了。

pattern.explain: turns out = 原来是/结果是；held up = 被耽搁/被拦
pattern.native: Turns out it's stuck at customs.

variations.en: Turns out the address was wrong.
It turns out the package is still at the warehouse.

pattern.extensions: 原来是/结果是…：发现问题原因时用

sentences.en: I've upgraded your shipping to express at no charge — it'll be there in 2 days.
sentences.zh: 我已经免费帮您升级到快递——2天内到。

pattern.explain: upgraded to express = 升级到快递；at no charge = 免费
pattern.native: I upgraded you to express — free of charge.

variations.en: I've upgraded your shipping at no cost.
variations.zh: 我已经免费升级了您的运输。

variations.en: We'll upgrade you to priority shipping for free.
variations.zh: 我们将为您免费升级至优先送货。

pattern.extensions: 免费升级：快递、VIP、优先

sentences.en: Is there anything else I can help you with today?
sentences.zh: 今天还有什么其他可以帮到您的吗？

pattern.explain: 万能结尾句 — 询问是否还有其他需求
pattern.native: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

variations.en: Is there anything else I can help you with today?
variations.zh: 今天是否还有其他事情需要我为您效劳？

pattern.extensions: 这个句式可以根据场景灵活替换关键词

sentences.en: Your order has been shipped and here's the tracking number.
sentences.zh: 您的订单已发货，这是快递单号。

pattern.explain: has been shipped = 已发货（被动语态）；tracking number = 快递单号
pattern.native: Your order's shipped — here's the tracking.

variations.en: Your package has been dispatched.
We've shipped your order — tracking number attached.
variations.zh: 我们已将您的订单发货，并附上了跟踪编号。

pattern.extensions: 已发货的标准表达 + 提供快递单号

sentences.en: The estimated delivery date is next Monday.
sentences.zh: 预计下周一到。

pattern.explain: estimated delivery date = 预计送达日期

variations.en: The estimated delivery is 3-5 business days.
variations.zh: 预计派送时间为3-5个工作日。

variations.en: We expect delivery by Friday.

pattern.extensions: 预计送达日期的多种表达

sentences.en: Your package is currently in transit.
sentences.zh: 您的包裹目前在途。

pattern.explain: in transit = 在途中（物流术语）

variations.en: Your package is currently in transit.
variations.zh: 您的包裹目前正在运输途中。

variations.en: The shipment is en route to your address.
variations.zh: 货件正在运送到您的地址。

pattern.extensions: 在途中的物流术语：in transit / en route / on the way

sentences.en: It takes about 3-5 business days to arrive.
sentences.zh: 大概需要3-5个工作日到。

pattern.explain: business days = 工作日（不含周末）；It takes + 时间 + to + 动词

variations.en: It takes 7-10 business days for international shipping.
variations.zh: 国际运输需要7-10个工作日。

variations.en: Allow 2-3 business days for processing.

pattern.extensions: 工作日表达：不含周末的计算方式

sentences.en: Shipping is free for orders over $50.
sentences.zh: $50以上免运费。

pattern.explain: free for orders over + 金额 → 满额免邮的表达

variations.en: Orders over $100 ship for free.
variations.zh: 超过$ 100的订单可免费送货。

variations.en: Free delivery on orders above $50.
variations.zh: 订单金额超过$ 50即可享受免费派送优惠。

pattern.extensions: 满额免邮的表达：free shipping / no shipping fee

sentences.en: We ship worldwide — let me check the shipping rate to your country.
sentences.zh: 我们全球发货——我查一下到您国家的运费。

pattern.explain: ship worldwide = 全球发货；shipping rate = 运费
pattern.native: We ship globally — let me check rates.

variations.en: We deliver to over 100 countries.
variations.zh: 我们向100多个国家/地区提供派送服务。

variations.en: We offer international shipping worldwide.
variations.zh: 我们在全球范围内提供国际航运。

pattern.extensions: 全球发货的表达 + 查询运费

sentences.en: The package was returned to sender — would you like me to resend it?
sentences.zh: 包裹被退回了——需要我重新发吗？

pattern.explain: returned to sender = 退回发件人；resend = 重新发送
pattern.native: Package was sent back — want me to resend?

variations.en: The courier returned it to sender — can we update the address?
variations.zh: 派送员已将其退还给发件人，我们可以更新地址吗？

variations.en: Your package was returned — shall I reship?
variations.zh: 您的包裹已退回—要重新发货吗？

pattern.extensions: 包裹退回后请求重新发送/更新地址

sentences.en: Customs clearance may take an additional 2-3 days.
sentences.zh: 清关可能需要额外2-3天。

pattern.explain: customs clearance = 清关；an additional + 时间 = 额外…时间

variations.en: Clearance typically takes 1-2 business days.
variations.zh: 结算通常需要1-2个工作日。

variations.en: Your package is awaiting customs clearance.
variations.zh: 您的包裹正在等待清关。

pattern.extensions: 清关相关：时间、状态、额外费用

sentences.en: I'll make sure your order goes out today if you confirm before 3 PM.
sentences.zh: 如果您下午3点前确认，我确保今天发货。

pattern.explain: I'll make sure + 从句 → 我确保…；goes out = 发出
pattern.native: Confirm by 3 PM and it ships today.

variations.en: If you confirm today, I'll make sure it goes out.
variations.zh: 如果您今天确认，我会确保它熄灭。

variations.en: I'll make sure your order is processed first.

pattern.extensions: 确保某事发生：今天发货、优先处理、锁定价格

sentences.en: The delivery address we have on file is — is that correct?
sentences.zh: 我们系统里的收货地址是——请问对吗？

pattern.explain: on file = 存档的/记录在案的；is that correct? = 对吗？
pattern.native: The address we have is... — correct?

variations.en: Is the address on file still current?
variations.zh: 登记的地址是否仍然是最新的？

variations.en: We have your details on file — is everything correct?
variations.zh: 我们有您的详细信息存档—一切都正确吗？

pattern.extensions: 确认系统里存档的信息：地址、电话、邮箱

sentences.en: Would you like me to change the shipping method to express?
sentences.zh: 需要我把物流方式改成快递吗？

pattern.explain: change A to B → 把A改成B；express = 快递
pattern.native: Want me to switch to express?

variations.en: Can I change the shipping method to standard?
variations.zh: 我可以将送货方式更改为标准送货方式吗？

variations.en: I'll change the address to the new one.
variations.zh: 我会将地址更改为新地址。

pattern.extensions: 把A改成B：物流方式、地址、数量

sentences.en: Your order is out for delivery today.
sentences.zh: 您的订单今天派送中。

pattern.explain: out for delivery = 派送中（物流状态术语）

variations.en: Your package is out for delivery — you'll get it today.
variations.zh: 您的包裹已送达，您将在今天收到包裹。

variations.en: The courier has your package and is on the way.
variations.zh: 派送员已收到您的包裹，正在派送途中。

pattern.extensions: 派送中：物流状态术语，表示今天会送到

sentences.en: The package requires a signature upon delivery.
sentences.zh: 这个包裹需要签收。

pattern.explain: requires a signature = 需要签名；upon delivery = 送达时

variations.en: A signature is required upon receipt.
Someone needs to sign for the package.

pattern.extensions: 需要签收：签名、确认收货、本人签收

sentences.en: I've added insurance to your shipment just in case.
sentences.zh: 我给您的包裹加了保险以防万一。

pattern.explain: just in case = 以防万一；insurance = 保险

variations.en: I added tracking insurance to be safe.
variations.zh: 为了安全起见，我添加了跟踪保险。

variations.en: We've included insurance for peace of mind.
variations.zh: 我们为您提供了保险，让您高枕无忧。

pattern.extensions: 以防万一：加保险、加备注、加确认

sentences.en: We use DHL for international shipments — it's faster and more reliable.
sentences.zh: 国际件我们用DHL——更快更可靠。

pattern.explain: We use A for B → 我们用A来做B；reliable = 可靠的
pattern.native: We use DHL for international — faster.

variations.en: We use FedEx for express shipments.
variations.zh: 我们使用联邦快递进行快递运输。

pattern.explain: includes...but excludes... → 包含...但不包含...；shipping = 运费

variations.en: The quote includes packaging and labeling.
Shipping is not included in the unit price.

pattern.extensions: include/exclude: 报价中常说明包含/不包含哪些费用

sentences.zh: 如果您能提供其他供应商的正式报价，我们可以匹配价格。

pattern.explain: match the price = 匹配/对标价格；formal quote = 正式报价；from another supplier 修饰来源

variations.en: We can beat that price by 5%.
variations.zh: 我们可以比那个价格低5%。

variations.en: Send us the competitor's quote and we'll match it.
variations.zh: 把竞争对手的报价发来，我们匹配。

pattern.extensions: 价格匹配：match / beat / price match guarantee

sentences.en: There's an additional 3% discount for orders over 2,000 units.
sentences.zh: 超过2000件的订单额外有3%的折扣。

pattern.explain: additional + 百分比 + discount → 额外折扣；over = 超过

pattern.extensions: additional/extra discount: 额外折扣，叠加在基础折扣上

sentences.en: Our prices are quoted in USD and valid for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 我们的价格以美元报价，有效期30天。

pattern.explain: quoted in + 货币 → 以某货币报价；valid for + 时间段 → 有效期
pattern.native: Prices are in USD, good for 30 days.

variations.en: All quotes are in USD and valid for two weeks.
variations.zh: 所有报价以美元为准，有效期两周。

variations.en: The price is valid until the end of the month.

pattern.extensions: 报价必说两件事：货币和有效期

sentences.en: The sample is free, but you'd need to cover the shipping cost.
sentences.zh: 样品是免费的，但您需要承担运费。

pattern.explain: cover the cost = 承担费用；you'd need to = you would need to

variations.en: We provide free samples — you just cover shipping.
variations.zh: 我们提供免费样品——您只需付运费。

variations.en: The sample charge will be refunded on your bulk order.
variations.zh: 样品费在大货订单中退还。

pattern.extensions: 样品费常见说法：free sample / sample charge / refundable on bulk order

sentences.en: We require a 30% deposit before production begins.
sentences.zh: 生产开始前我们需要30%的定金。

pattern.explain: require + 金额 + deposit → 需要定金；before production begins → 生产前

variations.en: A 50% deposit is required to start the order.
variations.zh: 需要50%定金才能开始订单。

variations.en: We need a 30% down payment before production.

pattern.extensions: deposit / down payment: 定金/预付款

sentences.en: The more you order, the better the unit price.
sentences.zh: 订得越多，单价越优惠。

pattern.explain: The more...the better... → 越...越...；unit price = 单价

variations.en: The larger the order, the lower the unit cost.
variations.zh: 订单越大，单位成本越低。

variations.en: Higher quantities mean better pricing.

pattern.extensions: The more...the... 句型在外贸报价中非常常用

sentences.en: This is our rock-bottom price — we can't go any lower.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的底价了——不能再低了。

pattern.explain: rock-bottom price = 底价；can't go any lower = 不能再低

variations.en: This is the lowest we can go.
variations.zh: 这是我们能给的最低价了。

variations.en: We've already hit rock bottom on this price.
variations.zh: 这个价格已经是底价了。

pattern.extensions: 底价表达：rock-bottom / floor price / bottom line

sentences.en: Prices may fluctuate depending on raw material costs.
sentences.zh: 价格可能会根据原材料成本波动。

pattern.explain: fluctuate = 波动；depending on = 取决于；raw material costs = 原材料成本

variations.en: Prices are subject to raw material market changes.
variations.zh: 价格受原材料市场变化影响。

variations.en: Material cost fluctuations may affect the final price.
variations.zh: 原材料成本波动可能影响最终价格。

pattern.extensions: fluctuate: 波动；常解释价格变动原因

sentences.en: We offer NET 30 payment terms for established customers.
sentences.zh: 我们为老客户提供30天账期。

pattern.explain: NET 30 = 收货后30天付款；established customers = 老客户/稳定客户

variations.en: We can offer NET 15 once we've done a few orders together.
variations.zh: 合作几次后可以给15天账期。

variations.en: NET 30 is available for orders above $10,000.
variations.zh: 一万美元以上订单可享30天账期。

pattern.extensions: NET + 天数: 账期表达，外贸常用

sentences.zh: 报价是EXW条件，所以运费另算。

pattern.explain: EXW = Ex Works 工厂交货价；so shipping is extra = 所以运费另算

variations.en: We quote FOB Shanghai — you arrange shipping from there.
variations.zh: 我们报FOB上海价——您从上海安排运输。

variations.en: The CIF price includes shipping and insurance.

pattern.extensions: 贸易术语：EXW/FOB/CIF/DDP — 决定谁承担运费和风险

sentences.en: Could you let me know your estimated annual demand?
sentences.zh: 您能告诉我您预估的年需求量吗？

pattern.explain: estimated annual demand = 预估年需求量；let me know = 告诉我

variations.en: What's your projected annual volume?
variations.zh: 您预计的年采购量是多少？

variations.en: How many units do you typically order per year?
variations.zh: 您通常每年订购多少件？

pattern.extensions: 了解客户采购量以便给阶梯报价

sentences.en: We can offer a 5% discount for your first trial order.
sentences.zh: 首次试单我们可以给5%的折扣。

pattern.explain: trial order = 试单；first = 首次

variations.en: We offer a special discount for first-time buyers.
variations.zh: 我们为首次购买的客户提供特别折扣。

variations.en: Your trial order qualifies for a 3% discount.

pattern.extensions: trial order: 试单，吸引新客户的常见策略

pattern.explain: varies depending on = 随...变化；color and size = 颜色和尺码
pattern.native: Price depends on color and size.

variations.en: Different specifications have different prices.
The price changes based on the material you select.
variations.zh: 价格根据您选的材质而变化。

pattern.extensions: varies depending on: 解释价格差异的常用句式

sentences.en: We'll need to charge a small fee for custom packaging.
sentences.zh: 定制包装我们需要收取少量费用。

pattern.explain: charge a fee = 收费；custom packaging = 定制包装
pattern.native: Custom packaging costs a bit extra.

variations.en: There's a $50 setup fee for custom logo printing.
variations.zh: 定制Logo印刷有50美元制版费。

variations.en: Custom packaging adds $0.20 per unit.

pattern.extensions: custom 相关费用：setup fee / custom charge

sentences.en: Our FOB price is $2.80 per unit.
sentences.zh: 我们的FOB价格是每件2.80美元。

pattern.explain: FOB = Free On Board 船上交货价；per unit = 每件

variations.en: The FOB Shanghai price is $1.50 per piece.
Our FOB price is $5.00 per unit for this model.

pattern.extensions: FOB + 港口名 + 价格: 外贸标准报价格式

sentences.zh: 让我为您分解一下成本。

pattern.explain: break down = 分解/明细；costs = 成本

variations.en: Here's a detailed cost breakdown.
Let me show you where the costs come from.
variations.zh: 让我给您看看成本构成。

pattern.extensions: break down: 把总价拆成明细给客户看

sentences.en: The unit price drops to $2.50 if you order 1,000 or more.

pattern.explain: drops to = 降到；if you order + 数量 = 如果订购...

variations.en: The price goes down to $1.20 at 5,000 units.
Unit cost drops to $3.00 for quantities above 2,000.

pattern.extensions: drops to / goes down to: 阶梯降价表达

sentences.en: We don't charge for logo printing on orders above 500 units.

pattern.explain: don't charge = 不收费；logo printing = Logo印刷；above = 以上

variations.en: Logo customization is free for orders over 1,000 units.
We waive the setup fee for bulk orders.

pattern.extensions: waive = 免除费用，促销常用

sentences.en: Prices are subject to change without prior notice.
sentences.zh: 价格如有变更恕不另行通知。

pattern.explain: subject to change = 可能变更；without prior notice = 不另行通知

variations.en: All prices are subject to change until order is confirmed.
variations.zh: 所有价格在订单确认前可能变动。

variations.en: We reserve the right to adjust prices.
variations.zh: 我们保留调整价格的权利。

pattern.extensions: subject to: 受...影响/可能... — 合同和报价中的免责声明

sentences.en: I can give you a special price if this becomes a regular order.
sentences.zh: 如果这成为常规订单，我可以给您特殊价格。

pattern.explain: special price = 特价；regular order = 常规/定期订单

variations.en: We offer better rates for recurring orders.
variations.zh: 定期订单享受更优价格。

variations.en: If you order monthly, I can lock in a lower price.
variations.zh: 如果您每月下单，我可以锁定更低价格。

pattern.extensions: regular/recurring order: 长期合作订单

sentences.zh: 标价是零售价——批发价低很多。

pattern.explain: retail price = 零售价；wholesale = 批发；much lower = 低很多
pattern.native: That's retail — wholesale is way cheaper.

variations.zh: 批发价约为零售价的4折。

variations.en: The retail price is for reference only.

pattern.extensions: retail vs wholesale: 零售与批发价格区分

sentences.en: We offer a volume discount starting at 300 units.

pattern.explain: volume discount = 量价折扣；starting at = 从...开始
pattern.native: Volume discount kicks in at 300 units.

variations.en: Quantity discounts begin at 500 pieces.
The first discount tier starts at 200 units.

pattern.extensions: volume/quantity discount: 量大优惠

sentences.en: There's a setup fee of $50 for custom designs.
sentences.zh: 定制设计有50美元的制版费。

pattern.explain: setup fee = 制版费/设置费；custom designs = 定制设计

variations.en: The mold fee is $200 for custom shapes.
There's a one-time tooling fee of $300.

pattern.extensions: setup/mold/tooling fee: 定制相关的一次性费用

sentences.zh: 选择标准包装可以省10%。

pattern.explain: save + 百分比 = 省...；standard packaging = 标准包装

variations.en: Choosing standard sizes reduces the cost by 8%.
variations.zh: 选择标准尺寸可降低8%成本。

variations.en: You'll save on costs by using our default design.
variations.zh: 用默认设计可以节省成本。

pattern.explain: depends on = 取决于；shipping method = 运输方式

variations.en: The total cost changes based on your shipping preference.
variations.zh: 总费用根据您的运输偏好而变化。

variations.en: Shipping method affects the final price.
variations.zh: 运输方式影响最终价格。

pattern.extensions: depends on: 解释价格不固定的常用表达

sentences.zh: 如果您愿意签年度合同，我们可以谈价格。

pattern.explain: negotiate = 谈判/协商；commit to = 承诺/签订；yearly contract = 年度合同
pattern.native: Sign a yearly deal and we'll talk price.

variations.en: We can offer better pricing with a long-term agreement.
variations.zh: 长期协议可以给更好的价格。

variations.en: A 12-month contract unlocks our best rates.

pattern.extensions: commit to: 承诺合作 — 用于引导客户签长期合同

sentences.en: This is a promotional price valid only until the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 这是促销价，仅有效到月底。

pattern.explain: promotional price = 促销价；valid only until = 仅有效到

variations.en: This offer expires on October 31st.
The promotion price is good through Friday.

pattern.extensions: promotional/offer: 限时促销价格表达

sentences.zh: CIF价格包含到您港口的保险和运费。

variations.en: The DDP price includes everything — shipping, duties, and delivery.
variations.zh: DDP价格包含一切——运费、关税和送货。

variations.en: FOB doesn't include insurance — that's on you.

pattern.extensions: CIF/DDP/FOB: 不同贸易术语下费用承担方不同

pattern.native: Credit terms available after a few orders.

variations.en: We extend credit to customers after three successful orders.
variations.zh: 三次成功订单后我们提供账期。

variations.en: Credit terms require a credit check first.

pattern.explain: included + 数量 + options → 提供选项；to choose from → 供选择

variations.en: Here are three tiers — pick whichever works best.

variations.zh: 一周内付款享3%早鸟折扣。

variations.zh: 如果您认可价格，我来起草发票。

variations.en: Let me know and I'll send over the proforma invoice.
variations.zh: 告诉我，我发形式发票给您。

pattern.explain: lower by + 百分比 = 降低...；switch to = 改用；simpler design = 更简单的设计

variations.zh: 减少颜色数量可降低5%成本。

variations.en: A standard design costs less than a custom one.
variations.zh: 标准设计比定制的便宜。

tvShows.name: The Office
tvShows.desc: 职场喜剧，商务+日常双修

expressions.en: That's what she said.
expressions.zh: 她就是这么说的。

expressions.en: Bears. Beets. Battlestar Galactica.
expressions.zh: 熊。甜菜。太空堡垒。

expressions.en: Would I rather be feared or loved? Easy. Both.
expressions.zh: 我更想被畏惧还是被爱？简单。都要。

expressions.en: I'm not superstitious, but I am a little stitious.
expressions.zh: 我不迷信，但我有一点点迷信。

expressions.en: Sometimes I'll start a sentence and I don't even know where it's going.
expressions.zh: 有时我开始说一句话，自己都不知道要说到哪。

expressions.en: I just want to lie on the beach and eat hot dogs.
expressions.zh: 我只想躺在沙滩上吃热狗。

expressions.en: I have a lot of questions. Number one, how dare you?
expressions.zh: 我有很多问题。第一个，你怎么敢？

expressions.en: Did I stutter?
expressions.zh: 我结巴了吗？

expressions.en: Identity theft is not a joke, Jim!
expressions.zh: 身份盗窃不是开玩笑的，Jim！

expressions.en: Why are you the way that you are?
expressions.zh: 你为什么是这样的？

expressions.en: I don't come up with this stuff, I just forward it along.
expressions.zh: 这些不是我编的，我只是转发。

expressions.en: Winners don't make excuses.
expressions.zh: 赢家不找借口。

expressions.en: I'm one of those people who doesn't have a filter.
expressions.zh: 我是那种说话不过脑子的人。

expressions.en: If I can't scuba, then what's this all been about?
expressions.zh: 如果不能潜水，那这一切是为了什么？

expressions.en: I am running away from my responsibilities. And it feels good.
expressions.zh: 我在逃避责任。感觉真好。

expressions.en: I talk a lot, so I've learned to tune myself out.
expressions.zh: 我话很多，所以学会了屏蔽自己。

expressions.en: The worst thing about prison was the dementors.
expressions.zh: 监狱最糟的是摄魂怪。

expressions.en: I'm not a bad guy. I'm just a guy who sometimes does bad things.
expressions.zh: 我不是坏人。我只是有时做坏事的人。

expressions.en: I feel like all my kids grew up and married each other.
expressions.zh: 感觉我的孩子们都长大互相结婚了。

expressions.en: You miss 100% of the shots you don't take.
expressions.zh: 你不尝试就100%错过。

expressions.en: Why the face?
expressions.zh: 怎么这个表情？

expressions.en: I'm cool. I'm hip. I'm with it.
expressions.zh: 我很酷。我很潮。我跟得上时代。

expressions.en: I'm not a regular mom, I'm a cool mom.
expressions.zh: 我不是普通妈妈，我是酷妈妈。

expressions.en: Do you even lift, bro?
expressions.zh: 你举铁吗，兄弟？

expressions.en: I'm like a chameleon. I can blend into any situation.
expressions.zh: 我像变色龙，能融入任何环境。

expressions.en: When life gives you lemonade, make lemons.
expressions.zh: 当生活给你柠檬水，就做柠檬。

expressions.en: I'm a father first, a husband second.
expressions.zh: 我首先是父亲，其次才是丈夫。

expressions.en: I'm not weird, I'm a limited edition.
expressions.zh: 我不怪，我是限量版。

expressions.en: That's not how the world works.
expressions.zh: 世界不是这样运作的。

expressions.en: I don't just meet expectations, I exceed them.
expressions.zh: 我不只是达到期望，我超越期望。

expressions.en: Always look on the bright side of life.
expressions.zh: 总是看生活的光明面。

expressions.en: I'm a go-getter. I go and get things.
expressions.zh: 我是行动派。我去得到东西。

expressions.en: The most important thing in life is family.
expressions.zh: 生活中最重要的是家庭。

expressions.en: I've always wanted to do that.
expressions.zh: 我一直想这么做。

expressions.en: You can't put a price on a good education.
expressions.zh: 好的教育是无价的。

tvShows.desc: 高智商对话，正式+犀利表达

expressions.en: The game is on.
expressions.zh: 游戏开始了。

expressions.en: I'm not a psychopath, I'm a high-functioning sociopath.
expressions.zh: 我不是精神病患者，我是高功能反社会者。

expressions.en: Brainy is the new sexy.
expressions.zh: 聪明是新的性感。

expressions.en: You see, but you do not observe.
expressions.zh: 你只是在看，而不是在观察。

expressions.en: Sentiment is a chemical defect found on the losing side.
expressions.zh: 感情是失败方的化学缺陷。

expressions.en: I never guess. It's a shocking habit.
expressions.zh: 我从不猜测。这是个令人震惊的习惯。

expressions.en: Data, data, data. I can't make bricks without clay.
expressions.zh: 数据，数据，数据。没有泥我做不了砖。

expressions.en: I'm a consulting detective. The only one in the world.
expressions.zh: 我是咨询侦探。世界上唯一的一个。

expressions.en: I dislike being outnumbered. It makes me uncomfortable.
expressions.zh: 我不喜欢寡不敌众。让我不舒服。

expressions.en: The world is full of obvious things which nobody observes.
expressions.zh: 世界充满了明显的事物，却没人观察到。

expressions.en: I am not a machine. I am a person.
expressions.zh: 我不是机器。我是人。

expressions.en: Don't make people into heroes. Heroes don't exist.
expressions.zh: 别把人变成英雄。英雄不存在。

expressions.en: You're not a hero. You're a fighter.
expressions.zh: 你不是英雄。你是战士。

expressions.en: The difference between knowing and guessing is everything.
expressions.zh: 知道和猜测之间的差异就是一切。

expressions.en: I'm the most unpleasant, rude, ignorant man.
expressions.zh: 我是最令人不快、粗鲁、无知的人。

expressions.en: You don't make decisions based on what's fair. You make them based on what's best.
expressions.zh: 你做决定不是基于什么公平，而是基于什么最好。

expressions.en: I'm not asking you to like it. I'm asking you to do it.
expressions.zh: 我不是要你喜欢它。我是要你做。

expressions.en: Don't just react. Anticipate.
expressions.zh: 不要只是反应。要预判。

expressions.en: I don't have time for your ego.
expressions.zh: 我没时间应付你的自尊。

expressions.en: Winners don't make excuses.
expressions.zh: 赢家不找借口。

expressions.en: It's not about what you know, it's about what you can prove.
expressions.zh: 不在于你知道什么，而在于你能证明什么。

expressions.en: Don't go to battle unless you know you can win.
expressions.zh: 除非你知道你能赢，否则不要开战。

expressions.en: I don't play the odds, I play the man.
expressions.zh: 我不赌概率，我赌人。

expressions.en: Loyalty is not a one-way street.
expressions.zh: 忠诚不是单行道。

expressions.en: You don't need a title to be a leader.
expressions.zh: 你不需要头衔才能成为领导者。

expressions.en: If you want something, go get it. Period.
expressions.zh: 如果你想要什么，就去争取。句号。

expressions.en: Sometimes good guys gotta do bad things to make the bad guys pay.
expressions.zh: 有时好人得做坏事才能让坏人付出代价。

expressions.en: You don't get to choose how you fall. You get to choose how you get back up.
expressions.zh: 你无法选择怎么倒下，但可以选择怎么站起来。

expressions.en: The only time you should look down on someone is when you're helping them up.
expressions.zh: 你唯一应该俯视别人的时候是你帮助他们站起来时。

expressions.en: I'm not in the business of making friends. I'm in the business of winning.
expressions.zh: 我不是来交朋友的。我是来赢的。

emailTemplates.title: Product Inquiry
emailTemplates.subject: Inquiry about {product}
emailTemplates.body:
Dear {supplier},

I am interested in your {product}. Could you please send me the following information:

1. Latest catalog and price list
2. Minimum order quantity (MOQ)
3. Sample availability and cost
4. Production lead time
5. Payment terms

Looking forward to your reply.

Best regards,
{your_name}

emailTemplates.title: Sample Request
emailTemplates.subject: Request for samples of {product}
emailTemplates.body:
Dear {supplier},

We are a cross-border e-commerce seller based in China. We would like to request samples of your {product} for quality evaluation.

Please let us know:
- Sample cost and shipping fee
- Expected delivery time
- Whether the sample cost can be refunded on bulk orders

Our shipping address:
{address}

Thank you.

Best regards,
{your_name}

emailTemplates.title: Price Comparison
emailTemplates.subject: Price inquiry for {product}
emailTemplates.body:
Hi {supplier},

We are comparing suppliers for {product}. Please provide your best price for the following quantities:

- {qty1} units
- {qty2} units
- {qty3} units

Also please confirm:
- Available colors and specifications
- Packaging details
- Certification (CE, FCC, RoHS, etc.)

Thank you.

Regards,
{your_name}

emailTemplates.title: Customization Inquiry
emailTemplates.subject: Custom {product} inquiry
emailTemplates.body:
Dear {supplier},

We are interested in customizing {product} with our own brand/logo. Could you please advise:

1. Do you offer OEM/ODM services?
2. What is the MOQ for customized products?
3. Can you provide a mockup design before production?
4. Additional cost for customization?
5. Lead time for customized orders?

We look forward to a long-term partnership.

Best regards,
{your_name}

emailTemplates.title: New Product Launch Inquiry
emailTemplates.subject: New product launch - {product}
emailTemplates.body:
Hi {supplier},

We noticed your new {product} on the market. We are very interested and would like to know more details.

Could you please share:
- Product specifications and features
- Wholesale pricing
- Stock availability
- Shipping options to China warehouse

We plan to list this product on Shopee and Lazada.

Best regards,
{your_name}

emailTemplates.title: Formal Quotation
emailTemplates.subject: Quotation for {product}
emailTemplates.body:
Dear {customer},

Thank you for your inquiry. Please find our quotation below:

Product: {product}
Unit Price: {price} (FOB Shenzhen)
MOQ: {moq} units
Payment Terms: 30% deposit, 70% before shipment
Lead Time: {lead_time} days after deposit
Packaging: Standard export packaging

Validity: This quote is valid for 30 days.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

Best regards,
{your_name}

emailTemplates.title: Discount Offer
emailTemplates.subject: Special offer for {product}
emailTemplates.body:
Hi {customer},

Thank you for your interest in our {product}.

We are happy to offer you the following pricing:

- {qty1}+ units: {price1} per unit
- {qty2}+ units: {price2} per unit (5% off)
- {qty3}+ units: {price3} per unit (10% off)

This special pricing is valid until {expiry}. Free samples are available for orders above {qty2} units.

Let me know which option works best for you.

Best regards,
{your_name}

emailTemplates.title: Price Increase Notice
emailTemplates.subject: Price adjustment notice - {product}
emailTemplates.body:
Dear {customer},

Due to rising raw material costs, we regret to inform you that the price of {product} will be adjusted by {percentage} starting from {date}.

The new unit price will be {new_price}.

However, we would like to offer you the opportunity to place orders at the current price before {date}. Any orders confirmed before this date will be honored at the old price.

We appreciate your understanding and continued partnership.

Best regards,
{your_name}

emailTemplates.title: Proforma Invoice
emailTemplates.subject: Proforma Invoice - {product}

emailTemplates.title: Quotation Follow-up
emailTemplates.subject: Following up on quotation for {product}
emailTemplates.body:
Hi {customer},

I sent you a quotation for {product} on {date}. I wanted to follow up and see if you have any questions or need any adjustments.

We can offer flexible payment terms and fast delivery. If you need a lower MOQ to test the market, please let me know and we can discuss.

Looking forward to your feedback.

Best regards,
{your_name}

emailTemplates.title: Payment Reminder
emailTemplates.subject: Payment reminder - Invoice {invoice_no}
emailTemplates.body:
Dear {customer},

This is a friendly reminder that the payment for Invoice {invoice_no} (total: {amount}) is due on {due_date}.

Please arrange the payment at your earliest convenience. Once the payment is made, please send us the bank slip so we can start processing your order.

If you have already made the payment, please disregard this email.

Thank you.

Best regards,
{your_name}

emailTemplates.title: Urgent Payment Request
emailTemplates.subject: URGENT: Payment needed for {product} order

emailTemplates.title: Balance Payment Request
emailTemplates.subject: Balance payment for Order {order_no}
emailTemplates.body:
Dear {customer},

Your order {order_no} ({product}) has been completed and is ready for shipment.

Please arrange the balance payment of {amount} ({percentage}) so we can ship the goods immediately.

Photos of the finished products are attached for your reference.

Thank you for your prompt attention.

Best regards,
{your_name}

emailTemplates.title: Payment Confirmation
emailTemplates.subject: Payment received - Order {order_no}

emailTemplates.title: Overdue Payment Notice
emailTemplates.subject: Overdue payment notice - {amount}
emailTemplates.body:
Dear {customer},

We noticed that the payment of {amount} for Invoice {invoice_no} was due on {due_date} and is now {days} days overdue.

We understand that delays can happen. Could you please let us know when we can expect the payment?

If there are any issues, please contact us so we can work together to find a solution.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,
{your_name}

emailTemplates.title: Shipping Notification
emailTemplates.subject: Your order {order_no} has been shipped

emailTemplates.title: Shipping Delay Notice
emailTemplates.subject: Shipping delay update - Order {order_no}

fields.name: compensation
fields.example: free shipping on your next order

emailTemplates.title: Customs Documents
emailTemplates.subject: Shipping documents for Order {order_no}
emailTemplates.body:
Dear {customer},

Please find attached the shipping documents for your order {order_no}:

1. Commercial Invoice
2. Packing List
3. Bill of Lading / Airway Bill
4. Certificate of Origin

Please review and let us know if everything is correct. If you need any additional documents for customs clearance, please inform us.

Best regards,
{your_name}

emailTemplates.title: Delivery Confirmation
emailTemplates.subject: Delivery confirmation - Order {order_no}
emailTemplates.body:
Dear {customer},

According to the tracking information, your order {order_no} has been delivered.

Could you please confirm that you have received the goods in good condition?

If there are any issues with the products, please contact us within 7 days and we will resolve them for you.

We would also appreciate it if you could leave us a review.

Thank you!

Best regards,
{your_name}

emailTemplates.title: Logistics Update Request
emailTemplates.subject: Logistics update needed for {product}
emailTemplates.body:
